newsitem.title: USA: NBC top executive stepping down - NYT.
newsitem.headline: NBC top executive stepping down - NYT.

text.p: A top executive at NBC who headed negotiations for a variety of deals at the U.S. TV network is resigning, the New York Times said.

In Wednesday's edition, the Times said John Agoglia, who headed talks that led to such deals as wooing comedian Jay Leno to take over the "Tonight" show to contracts for three co-stars of the "Seinfeld" show, is stepping down.

Agoglia, 60, had experienced some unspecified health problems in the past year, but said he is now "100 percent." However, he said, "this job is one you have to give 100 percent to. For a long time I've wanted more time with my family."
Agoglia was president of NBC Enterprises and was directly responsible for nearly all of the network's deals within the entertainment industry.
NBC is owned by General Electric Co.
